name: phone
label: Phone
help: Enter a phone or an email. For example, +14165550134. A 10-digit number is read as North American.

name: locale
label: Language
help: Language of the contact's reminders and confirmations. If left empty, they use the business's language when it is one of these, else English.

name: timezone
label: Time zone
help: The contact's time zone, such as America/Toronto.
